# Security reports

Use GitHub’s private **Report a vulnerability** feature on the repository’s Security tab when available. If it is unavailable, open an issue asking for a private contact channel without posting exploit details or secrets.

Never attach signing keys, certificate passwords, Samsung account credentials, TV serial/DUID information, private recovery state or account screenshots. Ordinary bugs and compatibility results belong in the issue forms.

Only the latest public preview receives active fixes. Older versions remain available for recovery, without a promise of ongoing security maintenance. The source and unsigned artifacts contain no owner credentials. Each TV owner signs locally; no shared signing identity or remote signing service is provided.

The optional native helper sources concern undocumented TV preferences and are separate from the web application. Do not weaken their firmware/architecture/identity guards or run them against someone else’s television.
